tooltip: This session will use the weight value you entered for this user at the Users menu.

name: Enable LSL Output
tooltip:
Toggle to stream data over LabStreamingLayer (LSL).
Stream name and source ID are configured in Settings.

name: Enable TCP Output
tooltip:
Toggle to send data over a TCP connection.
Host and port are configured in Settings.

name: Window Size
tooltip: Duration of data used per computation window. Larger windows smooth metrics; smaller windows react faster.

name: Window Slide (Hop)
tooltip: Time step between consecutive windows. Smaller hops update graphs more often with more overlap.

name: Sampling Rate
tooltip: Uniform resampling rate used after interpolation. Higher f_s captures faster sway but increases compute.

name: Interpolation Method
tooltip: How irregular COP samples are resampled to uniform time. Affects spectra and velocity estimates.

name: Save Location
tooltip: Folder where session outputs are stored.

name: Center of Pressure (X)
equation: COP_x = ((TR + BR) − (TL + BL)) / (TR + BR + TL + BL)
tooltip: Lateral COP position (unitless ratio, ~−1 left to +1 right).

name: Center of Pressure (Y)
equation: COP_y = ((TR + TL) − (BR + BL)) / (TR + BR + TL + BL)
tooltip: Anterior–posterior COP position (unitless ratio, ~−1 back to +1 front).

name: Total Force
tooltip: Total load on the board (Newtons).

name: Stability Index
tooltip: RMS distance of COP from its mean (unitless).

name: Mean Velocity (X)
tooltip: Average absolute COP velocity along X (units: ratio/s).

name: Mean Velocity (Y)
tooltip: Average absolute COP velocity along Y (units: ratio/s).

name: Mean Velocity
tooltip: Average resultant COP speed (units: ratio/s).

name: Total Path Length
tooltip: Total distance traveled by COP (unitless path length in ratio units).

name: Velocity Moment
tooltip: Average speed of COP over time (units: ratio/s).

name: Medio-Lateral Stability Index
tooltip: RMS COP excursion along X (unitless ratio).

name: Anterior–Posterior Stability Index
tooltip: RMS COP excursion along Y (unitless ratio).

name: Vertical Stability Index
tooltip: RMS deviation of force from baseline load (Newtons).

name: Dynamic Postural Stability Index
equation: DPSI = sqrt( (1/N) * Σ_i [ x_i^2 + y_i^2 + (baseline − z_i)^2 ] )
tooltip: Combined RMS of medio-lateral, anterior–posterior, and vertical components.

name: Confidence Ellipse (95%)
equation: r1 = sqrt(χ²₂(0.95)·λ1), r2 = sqrt(χ²₂(0.95)·λ2), θ = eigenvector angle
tooltip: Ellipse enclosing ~95% of COP points (unitless).

name: Convex Hull
equation: Polygon enclosing all {(x_i, y_i)} with minimal convex boundary
tooltip: Smallest convex polygon containing all COP points (unitless).

name: Load File
tooltip: Choose a ".settings.json" file to view a previous session.

name: Amplitude Spectrum
equation: A_x(f_k) = scale·|FFT_x[k]|, A_y(f_k) = scale·|FFT_y[k]|, A_xy = sqrt(A_x^2 + A_y^2)
tooltip: Frequency amplitudes of COP (unitless ratios vs Hz).

name: TCP Address
tooltip: Enter the server address in IPv4 format or hostname.
description: Must be reachable from this device.

name: Raw Data
tooltip: Toggle to send raw sensor readings from the Wii Balance Board. The format is:

name: Processed Data
tooltip: Toggle to send computed metrics.
description: This includes derived values rather than raw forces.

name: LSL Stream Name
tooltip: Name for the LabStreamingLayer stream.
description: Used by LSL clients to subscribe to this stream.

name: LSL Source ID
tooltip: Unique identifier for the LSL source.
description: Must remain stable across sessions so receivers can recognize the same device.

name: Default Save Location
tooltip: Path to the directory where output files will be saved by default.

name: Store Raw Data
tooltip: Toggle to store raw sensor data.

name: Store Processed Data
tooltip: Toggle to store processed data.
description: Includes COP (center of pressure), stability metrics, and spectral features.

name: Window Size
tooltip: Set the size of the analysis window.

name: Slide Size
tooltip: Set the size of the sliding window.

name: Sampling Rate
tooltip: Set the sampling rate for data acquisition.

name: Interpolation Method
tooltip: Select the interpolation method for resampling data.

name: Demo Mode
tooltip: Toggle demo mode to simulate sensor input.
